task.title: Native daily-driver performance Phase 2: candidates ready, before/after accepted; awaiting release authorization

result.summary: Server candidate afdc849a (base prod a399916a) and Native candidate c736254b (base Build 60 00321dcc) are ready, not deployed/uploaded. Before->after on production data with identical parity digests: Home warm 1.69->0.97 s, cold 3.33->1.79 s (compute -54%); Training Logger 1.45/2.50->0.98/1.11 s; Progress Photos 1.29->0.33 s; Training landing 1.65 MB->148 KB, library 191->12.6 KB, Nutrition 1.27->0.64 MB (Native-only projections keeping every Build 60 decode key); Evidence Hub ~3.2->~1.0 MB. Native: cold-launch Home paints a labelled same-day last-known snapshot in ~4 ms; Priority Detail acknowledges completion after the durable command instead of after a full Home read (~2-3.3 s -> command round trip); 19 read screens keep their view model; only the visible screen refreshes on resume. No common path >3 s remains (composed). HealthKit/Cardio paths unchanged. STOP for Founder release authorization.

tests.summary: Server: focused suites pass; full unit suite 301 pre-existing environment failures identical to a399916a, +17 new passing; production webpack build passes on afdc849a. Native: unit 1395/1395; FounderServerAPITests 201/201 (13 new); UI 11/12 with one pre-existing flake (testReportingJourneys) that passes on recheck.

review.summary: Two fresh-context adversarial reviews (Server, Native): nothing blocking; medium/low findings fixed in afdc849a / c736254b.

zero_write_audit.summary: All production benchmarks ran READ ONLY with a SELECT/WITH-only guard and ROLLBACK; parity digests identical for every non-projected resource.

decisions_required: Authorize Server deploy of afdc849a (backward compatible with installed Build 60).
Authorize Native Build 61 release prep from c736254b after HealthKit Cardio acceptance closes.
unexpected_findings: Priority Detail completion acknowledgement waited on a full canonical Home read.
Home read twice at cold launch in production logs (cause unproven without a device trace).
backlog: Phase 3: pre-projected/bounded read models for Home/Log/Goals/Morning Check-In (DB 0.5-1.1 s).
Auth last-seen writes off the read path; DB pool size 5 -> 10 (spec change).
Proactive access-token refresh; release-safe Native timing diagnostics.
Last-known snapshots for Log/Evidence Hub; Training Logger alias index.
recommended_next_step: Founder authorizes Server afdc849a deploy first (then rerun the benchmark against the live SHA); Build 61 from c736254b later.
